description: Create a new view in an Airtable table. Optionally copy configuration from an existing view. View types: "grid", "form", "kanban", "calendar", "gallery", "gantt", "levels" (list view).

copyFromViewId.description: Optional: view ID to copy configuration from (creates a fresh view with same settings).

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

tableId.description: The table ID to create the view in

name: create_view
